newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 11.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 11.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 11.0 percent on Tuesday morning on sufficient supply despite the share offering by PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI), dealers said.
They said generous supply by the central bank seemed to have helped keep the market stable at present, but operators were watching out for liquidity conditions at the weekend.
The BNI share offer will end on Thursday.
The central bank had injected some 881 billion rupiah on Tuesday morning in anticipation of a heavy oversubscription of the BNI share offer, dealers said.
Some dealers said overnight money might edge up slightly following rises in overnight swap to 0.45 from 0.35/0.45.
Longer-term rates were stable, with one-week money quoted at 14.00/14.25 percent and three-month at 15.25/15.50 percent.
The average overnight interbank rate on Monday was 11.53 percent, compared with 11.46 percent on Friday.
